{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(data.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(data.head())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print('\nNumber of unique patient_id:', data['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Total rows:', len(data))
print('Duplicate patient_id count:', len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print('\nCount of -999 in biomarker_baseline:', (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check assay_batch values
print('\nUnique assay_batch values:', data['assay_batch'].unique())

# Check arm values
print('\nUnique arms:', data['arm'].unique())

# Check responded values
print('\nResponded value counts:')
print(data['responded'].value_counts())"}
